name: Michele Tafoya
summary: Michele Joan Tafoya (born December 17, 1964) is an American former journalist and sports broadcaster. She worked for ABC, NBC, CBS, and ESPN. After beginning her career on Minneapolis-St.Paul-based radio and television stations, she became the host of CBS Sports Spectacular in 1994. Tafoya later joined ABC and ESPN, covering football and basketball.
